== Summary ==
Identified: [[Quirin Fürgut]] (front right, black Le Coq Sportif hoodie). Remaining faces unlabeled.
Players at Zu Den Vier Winden in Bochum, Germany, during the [[2018 European Championship]].

* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2020-09-30
* '''Identification:''' the post names nobody; faces are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]]. The player name boards on the wall (Cedrik V, Casper J, Emil W, Floris dV) match the 2018 field, and the poster attended in 2018.
